title: Prove exact numerical lifetimes for BIT validation prefix
body:
The remaining initialization/validation phase in PR2815 had no bound above the same `Consumer.apply` entry baseline as the earlier numerical components. This package proves its exact index peak is 18 Words at depth zero, 22 at positive depth without a halving unit step, and 23 when halving occurs. The halving branch retains an extra `f` Word during its second division.

For the unchanged PR2697 source, the complete prefix ending immediately before `packet_engine.run` has residue peak 4096 and exact additional occupied numerical content `max(4096*r, 2*r + K*i)`, where r/i include each Word's RIGHT delimiter and K is 18/22/23. All entry residents and the two arena templates are accounted separately. The category maxima occur in different phases; this is not a whole caller or physical reserve claim.

The written source proof includes initialization, serialized program/field validation, arbitrary valid finite depth, prime-power arithmetic, ownership and successful cleanup. A separate storage-lifetime AI specialist independently derives an integer allocation model. Literal source fixtures use neutral grammar-valid metadata; actual selected catalogue membership and packet/GL64 execution are not certified.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12 replay; 82 literal fixtures with exact entry preservation and 14 defect/integrity control groups; independent 4229 index histories and 1829 residue cases; exact cross-model agreement for all 82 literal peaks; optimized read-only Git-free CPython 3.14 replay; selected-record bindings. All source exports authenticate exact Git/SHA256 bytes before execution, including an effective stale-bytecode control. Details and the distinction between finite execution and written proof are in `research/selected-validation-numerical-lifetime/VALIDATION.md`.

Sources: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2697 at a53fdf4; Nick Petalas PR2759/2801/2815 and earlier numerical components; Ross Richardson PR2810; Arham Tahir PR2796 and David Arias PR2753 retain their distinct scopes. Full original notice and Apache-2.0 license are retained. New work by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex and separate AI specialist assistance; no independent human or formal-kernel proof.

Scientific base `544a7e8` is deliberately retained. Canonical main refreshed to `3398fea3` at 2026-10-15 23:38 UTC, priority 5, with unchanged relevant guidance/selected record/runner and no package collision. Submission metadata overlap completely paginated 704 open PRs including drafts and 1466 Discussion/comment/reply records, plus 2066 local records, at 23:38–23:42 UTC with no warnings. It excludes arbitrary diffs, unpublished work and closed work absent the local ledger; it is not a novelty certificate. [Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18960943).

Next: inventory remaining non-ADD and child-return phases under the same entry baseline, then separately join physical backing/movement and other content categories. No selected-frontier change, supplier admission or new kappa.
